\begin{table}[htbp]
\caption{Robustness of the coupled-edge criterion. Giant component $S$ of the coupled subgraph on the randomized network, $n=600$, $4\times10^{5}$ steps, $N=24$ realisations, as the rate $w$ above which an edge is called coupled is varied across the gap between the two bands of Fig.~4(b) of the main text. The value used throughout is $10\epsilon^{2}=10^{-3}$. Over the decade from $3\times10^{-4}$ to $3\times10^{-3}$ the order parameter moves by less than $0.012$ in the coupled phase; outside it the criterion fails, the exploration floor percolating by itself at a cut of $\epsilon^{2}$ and genuinely coupled edges being deleted at $5\times10^{-3}$.}
\label{supp:robust}
